description: This file defines an interface for processing capitalized income amortization related to loans, including methods for handling loan closure, charge-offs, undoing charge-offs, and processing up to a certain date.

classes.name: LoanCapitalizedIncomeAmortizationProcessingService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for processing capitalized income amortization tasks in the context of loan accounts.

methods.name: processCapitalizedIncomeAmortizationOnLoanClosure
methods.description: Handles amortization processing when a loan is closed, with an option to add journal entries.

methods.name: processCapitalizedIncomeAmortizationOnLoanChargeOff
methods.description: Processes amortization when a loan charge-off occurs, taking into account the associated transaction.

methods.name: processCapitalizedIncomeAmortizationOnLoanUndoChargeOff
methods.description: Handles amortization rollback when a previous charge-off is undone.

methods.name: processCapitalizedIncomeAmortizationTillDate
methods.description: Processes amortization up to a specified date, with an option to add journal entries.
